name: Tide Tabs
description: Tabs over a shallow channel whose indicator is a pool of water that flows to the chosen tab, stretching on the way and gathering when it arrives.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Lay the channel out as a row above the panel, or as a column beside it.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: The id of the current tab (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: The id of the tab shown first (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when another tab is chosen.

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: Whether arrow keys switch panels straight away, or only move focus until Enter or Space.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Tabs.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the set of tabs for assistive technology.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the water. Labels under the water take `brand-foreground`, so pick a colour that reads with it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the row of tabs inside the channel. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components TabList.

props.name: id
props.description: Matches the id of the TideTabPanel this tab shows.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, optionally with a lucide icon. It changes colour exactly where the water covers it.

props.name: id
props.description: Matches the id of its TideTab.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel content. It rises in a few pixels when its tab is chosen.

props.name: shouldForceMount
props.description: Keep the panel in the DOM while it is hidden.
